book.name: Yon
book.title: Yon Dowan Weng Olo Yone Dolanebuotabe.

content: Nakai teniba Yesuse afu debeb onsiobe.
Yesuse Gode wengo ohabeo blimanoa deibonea esa e okok aleyemin naka nisa tanoba aaye niniino Kidlone baaninobe, e daal tam helanoba watnoba as olib san dolimin wat beboba

Gode amo kimanin nakai komokwal isa eka Felisie isa i Gode amo deib toulalin naka maki baabeniba Ibo moniba Yudase bekeba unine ge baabeniba dlaiba moniba Yudase Yesuse komokwali dobyamabe naka esu ye mo temiba Yudase ni sinwalo Yesuse dletnea monoba damib olo une bianoba tekein kebinabe kesoa e awa genalin naka maki dlonea eka Gode amo deib toulalin naka eli dlonanea i ayal osa kwam osa oletniba teniba damib ele tetemsiobe.
Yesuse inamin namin olo e dimo tam tlamabo e sin tekein kebe kesoa e monea isu meb unanea baabenea Ibo waneta hen tebibe? gesea
i baabaniba Ni Yesuse Nasalet bib sak eta hen tebuobo gesiba e baabenea Banetabo ge baabesebe. Yudase Yesuse komokwali dobyebio naka esa i baka bietabe.
Yesuse baabenea Banetabo ge baanabea i abuk sin nininiba gimon sin dleb daaknoa blam biniba imin hana utesiba
Yesuse imin baabenea Ibo waneta hen tebibe? gesea isak imin baabaniba Yesuse Nasalet bib sak eta hen tebuobo gesiba
Yesuse baabenea Ne sin baabenia Banetabo gabi ole ibo neta hen tebib biamo ne okok aleyemin naka elile deibeiba unine ge baabesebe.
E weng olo baaseo e sino Gode baabanea Nakai kobo donebbuei ne kima blia i alukum klayam blib otane elekiem eta aseinin bib unamabebo ge baabanebuo weng olo bain ansobe.
Saimon Fitae e bainate tobonea Gode amo kimanin nakai i komok sume e okok nakae, e niniino Malkase, ananang genea klone kweital da eta taisanea tesea
Yesuse Fitae baabanea Keb bainate toboneba ele mib tem tobtenanale! Ne Aye nemfakanea baatnenea Kobo enin kino watemale genebio kesoa ne inanamabibo, kobo mo tolobo genemebe ge baabasebe.
Awa genalin nakai Yesuse afu debetniba moniba Anas esu onsiobe.
Yesuse Fitae inangge baabasea awa genalin naka isa eka i kimanin naka esa eka Yudai deib toulalin naka isa i Yesuse afuniba sayo gebaniba
debeb moniba komoke Anase Kaiafase molim esu onsiobe. Bifole ye dime Kaiafase Gode amo kimanin nakai komok sum am bietabe.

Sino Kaiafas ele e meletani Yudai komokwal maki baabenea Naka elekiem ele ananoba kaanemeo Lom teni Yuda nibo alukumo mo yalaibbabe. E ananoba kaanemeo nibo alukum daabenea klayam nomabbio kesoa kukub olo klayamobo gebanebio naka etabe.
Fitae baanea Ne Yesuse okok aleyemin nakababo gesebe.

Saimon Fitae tem eka Yesuse okok aleyemin naka make tem naniba i Yesuse debeb unibo kan moniba Gode amo kimanin nakai komok sume am onsiobe. Yesuse okok aleyemin naka ele Gode amo kimanin nakai komok sume tekein kebe kesoa i Yesuse debeb talaniba daam tem unibo e kan unea eka Fita ele bib tam bia Yesuse okok aleyemin naka ele inanea baka tam danea imin tanea unango amito kimabuo baabonea Ne neke mo debeb tam tlamine? gesea o Ae gesoa e Fitae baaba debetnea dab tamniba daam tem tam bliba
unang olo Fitae baabanoa Kebsa naka ele okok aleyemin nakabo gesoa e baabonea Yeye ne e okok aleyemin nakababo gesea
deibanoa okok naka isa eka Gode amo deib toulalin naka isa gil dububesoa ase fa tefubibo Fitae ye baka bianea ase tefu monsebe.
Gode amo kimanin nakai komok sume Yesuse kil oha monsebe.
Gode amo kimanin nakai komok sume Yesuse e okok aleyemin nakai wengo kil baabanea Yesuse yang kesea e imin baabanea Kobo keb wengo nakaia unangai omkaye binabeb weng osa baatnenale ge baabasea

Yesuse baabanea Ne wengo nakaia unangai ayoko mo omkaye binabibabe. Ne monia Yudai Gode am temo minabibo keim ye omkeima biania eka Yudai Gode am sumo tem tamo minabib biam osa monia keim ye omkaye biam binabibe.
Kobo nimin kenebta ne kil onebebe? Nakaia unangai ne wengo wente binabibi tekein kebiobo, ita baabenebta baabkeine ge baabasea
eka Gode am sumo deib toulalin naka make Yesuse wengo wentenea baabanea Kobo Gode amo kimanin nakai komok sume inamin wengo mo ohamebe ge baanea watnea keneng wat biangowabasea

Yesuse baabanea Ne weng misiam baanimio kobo baaneba Yo misiam nanebobo genamin otane ne wengo ayamo olota obi yole kobo nimin kenebta nananebe? ge baabane otane naka ele mo yang ke baabaim blimobe. E deibanea
Yesuse sayo gebaibbuo sma teksa ye bia Anase dabanea monea Gode amo kimanin nakai komok sume Kaiafas esu onsebe.
Fitae imin baanea Ne Yesuse okok aleyemin nakababo gesebe.
Saimon Fitae sma aseinin ye mabianea aso tefubea naka maki baabaibo Kebsa e okok aleyemin naka kebtabo gesiba e baabenea Yeye ne e okok aleyemin nakababo ge baabesea

Yesuse afu dobonabib dimo Fitae bainate tobo blelanea Gode amo kimanin nakai komok sume okok nakae klone tabiabanea unibe e ninek make ye bianea esa Fitae baabanea Kebsa damib wato ye bieba katem tlibiobo gesea
Fitae imin Yeye genabea weng tosa yota kakaluke nganasebe.
I Yesuse debeb moniba Lomo komoke Failat esu onsiobe.

Yudai Yesuse Kaiafase amo deiboniba debeb moniba Lomo komoke Failate am onsiobe. I inaniba onsibo amo bomanang genabotabe. Yudai singkalin am sumo tlang genabo kesoa i funaniba Nib hekmel wengo baanoa Fasoba imeno dowonomabib amo meb tebiamo ibo Yudabai amo mo unaibe! Ibo inanimibo Gode kin dimo misiam anomabiobo genobiobo ge funaniba i amo tam onamino deiboniba bib tam bliba
Failate tam tenea baabenea Naka ele fatnane biota kot kebanom genibte? gesea
Yudai komokwali baabaniba E kukub misiamo mo naim blim biameo ni mo debeb tenobta kebsuo mo tlaobbabe. E misiam naseta debeb tlobobo gesiba
Failate baabenea Ibmaye debeb moniba ilib hekmel wengo baanobio inaniba kot kebaine gesea i baabaniba Lom sel ib hekmel wengo baanoa Ibo nakai mo yenaiba kaanimibe genobiobo ge baabasiobe.
(Sino Yesuse e okok aleyemin naka ni baabenea I ne atdimo nemasaniba silo biki nenaiba kaanamabibo ge baabenebuo Lom teni Yesuse inabasib olo e wengo bain ansobe.)
I Failate inangge baabasiba e deibe tanea am tam unanea Yesuse nganabanea tesea baabanea Kobo Yudai komok sum kebtio? gesea
Yesuse baabanea Kobo weng olo kebmaye kleb bobol tem funanebta baaneb bleka naka mak ita ne weng sango baabkeibbiota baanebo? gesea
Failate baabanea Ne keb ninek Yudababe. Kleb ninek isa eka kleb Gode amo kimanin nakai komokwal isa imaye kemeb teniba nesu ele daibobe. Kobo fatnamin kukub misiam nanebbiote? gesea

Yesuse baabanea Ne dabalim olo kimanin naka biamio ne meletan item eka nakai ne nafu nemeb tlibbue item naniba awa geniba i ne tolobo geiba klabuto mo getnenomabibbabe. Ne kimanino afet kesota ne meletani Yudai komokwali mo tolobo geim blim deibeibta klabuto ge nemeb tliobo gesea

Failate baabanea Kobo baaneba Ne komok sumobo gabebo? gesea Yesuse baabanea Kobo baatneneba Kobo komok sumobo gabebo? ge baatneneb olo bainobe. Gode nemfakanea nemaneta daakenita dabalim olo tlita ne biemo nemfanobiobe. Ne dabalim olo tlibuo weng moton omkeimamano genita daakenita dabalim olo tlibiobe. Nakaia unangai weng motono i bobol tem daako bibebuei ne wengo wente binabiobo ge baabasea
Failate baabanea Weng moton ole fatnamine? ge baabanea e imin tanea bib tam unanea Yudai baabenea Ne dobo ohabi otane e misiamo nanebio ne mo watemin blimobe.

Otane Yuda ib kukub inaminobe. Bifole elekiem elekieme dime ibo Fasoba imeno dowonom gaibo Lomo komok ne nakai klabutam biaibo Yuda ibmaye baatneniba Nakae yeta tileisaneba uneko genimibo ne tileisaia onon binabib inania Yuda ib komok sum esa tileisabenano gesea
i ngambianiba Yeye kobo naka ele deibaneba Balabas eta tileisaneba tleko ge ngan monsiobe. Balabas ele naka maki yemde dlanea afobeingo ayok oiseneta klabuto ge debeb te daibbiotabe.
